releases.notes:
**Quality release: one new feature and a round of fixes for every supported Minecraft version.**

## New

- **Back to your launcher account.** Once you switch away from the account the game was started
  with, a **Back to <name>** button returns to it without a restart, even though that account is
  not saved in Keychain. Like every switch, it waits until you leave the world you are in.
- **Keyboard search.** Arrow keys pick a result without leaving the search box, and Enter switches
  to it.
- The account list opens scrolled to your current account and keeps its scroll position and
  keyboard focus when the window is resized.

## Fixed

- **Realms kept using the previous account.** The Realms list, invitations and news still belonged
  to the account the game was started with, and a "cannot sign in to Realms" answer from that
  account stuck until restart. Realms now follows the switch.
- **Telemetry was still sent in the previous account's name** after a switch.
- **A queued switch could happen in the middle of a connection.** Server networks (Velocity,
  BungeeCord) briefly unload the world while moving you between servers. Keychain took that for
  "left the world" and switched your account underneath the live connection. A queued switch now
  waits until you are back at a menu.
- **Add Offline Account: the typed name went nowhere** if you had last used Tab or the arrow keys,
  because *Cancel* had the focus instead of the name box.
- **Two games starting for the first time at once** could leave one of them with "saved accounts
  could not be unlocked".
- Two instances sharing one account list could undo each other's change when both saved within the
  same second.
- **Start fresh** checks the vault once more first and moves nothing if it opens after all. The
  screen also shows the actual reason the vault could not be opened.
- A Microsoft session renewed during a switch is saved even if you picked another account meanwhile.
- **Undo** puts the account back exactly as it was removed and restores *Remember account*.
- Skins no longer flash back to the default skin while they are refreshed.
- Smaller fixes: search focus survives screen rebuilds, no overlapping text in Settings on very
  small windows, settings are saved atomically, the sign-in page works when Java prefers IPv6.

## Tested

35 unit tests, and the in-game test, which now also clicks **Back to <name>**, checks that Realms
and telemetry follow the switch, picks search results with the arrow keys and adds an offline
account after keyboard navigation. It passes on 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.2 and 26.3.

## Download

Replace your old Keychain jar with **one** of these:

| Minecraft | File |
| --- | --- |
| 1.21.11 | `keychain-4.1.0+mc1.21.11.jar` |
| 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2 | `keychain-4.1.0+mc26.1.jar` |
| 26.2 | `keychain-4.1.0+mc26.2.jar` |
| 26.3 | `keychain-4.1.0+mc26.3.jar` |
| any of the above | `keychain-4.1.0-universal.jar` |

Your saved accounts carry over; nothing to redo.

releases.notes:
**Bug-fix release — please update if you play on Minecraft 26.3.**

## Fixed

- **26.3: clicking accounts did nothing.** Minecraft 26.3 numbers the left mouse button differently
  from older versions, and Keychain still expected the old number. Clicks on account rows were
  ignored, so you could not select an account, double-click to switch, use the hover **Use** button,
  or click the favorite star.
- **26.3: Ctrl+F (search) and Ctrl+Z (undo) did nothing**, for the same kind of reason.
- Switching to a Microsoft account on 26.3 now reuses the game's own, already connected Minecraft
  services client, so services are never briefly unavailable right after a switch.

1.21.11, 26.1 and 26.2 had none of these problems, but get the same jar update.

## Tested

The in-game test now does what a player does: it double-clicks account rows and clicks the star
with the real mouse, presses Ctrl+F, and checks that Minecraft services answer right after an online
switch. It passes on 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.2 and 26.3. The click test fails on 4.0.0.

## Download

Replace your old Keychain jar with **one** of these:

| Minecraft | File |
| --- | --- |
| 1.21.11 | `keychain-4.0.1+mc1.21.11.jar` |
| 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2 | `keychain-4.0.1+mc26.1.jar` |
| 26.2 | `keychain-4.0.1+mc26.2.jar` |
| 26.3 | `keychain-4.0.1+mc26.3.jar` |
| any of the above | `keychain-4.0.1-universal.jar` |

Your saved accounts carry over; nothing to redo.

releases.notes:
**Keychain 4.0.0 is a complete rewrite.** Switch Microsoft and offline Minecraft accounts in-game, now
on **Minecraft 1.21.11, 26.1 – 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3** (Fabric). Your accounts from Keychain 3.x and
older are imported automatically.

![Keychain account list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Domsimus-63/Keychain/main/docs/screenshots/accounts.png)

## Download

Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api),
then put **one** of these in your `mods` folder (remove the old Keychain jar first):

| Minecraft | File |
| --- | --- |
| 1.21.11 | `keychain-4.0.0+mc1.21.11.jar` |
| 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2 | `keychain-4.0.0+mc26.1.jar` |
| 26.2 | `keychain-4.0.0+mc26.2.jar` |
| 26.3 | `keychain-4.0.0+mc26.3.jar` |
| any of the above | `keychain-4.0.0-universal.jar` (picks the right build for you) |

## Highlights

- **Switching that works on real servers.** Keychain now rebuilds chat-signing keys, the services
  connection, your profile and skin, and (26.2+) the friends list for the new account. Servers with
  secure chat accept you right after switching.
- **Safe mid-game.** Switch from the pause menu and it happens the moment you leave the world, so your
  current connection never breaks. Changed your mind? Click *Stay here*.
- **Microsoft sign-in like the official launcher**, in your browser, with plain-language explanations
  when something goes wrong (no Xbox profile, child account, game not owned, ...).
- **Accounts stay signed in.** Tokens are checked before every switch and refreshed when needed, and
  rarely used accounts are renewed in the background so they don't expire after 90 days.
- **New account screen:** 3D skin preview, search (Ctrl+F), filters, favorites, your own order,
  double-click or hover **Use** to switch, Undo after removing, Copy UUID.
- **Stronger storage:** AES-256-GCM with a random key kept outside your Minecraft folder (protected by
  Windows on Windows). Sharing a modpack or instance no longer shares your logins.
- **More ways in:** key button on the title screen, pause menu and server list, an optional
  *Open Keychain* key, and a Mod Menu *Configure* button.
- **Settings:** choose where buttons appear, remember your last account, share accounts between
  instances, custom Azure app ID.
- **English, German and Turkish.**

## Upgrading from 3.x

- Accounts and favorites are imported on first start; the old `config/account-switcher.json` is
  renamed to `account-switcher.json.migrated`.
- The mod ID changed to `keychain`. Keychain 4 won't load next to an old Keychain jar — remove it.

The full list of changes is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Domsimus-63/Keychain/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
